chunks: We have also previously elucidated the difference between the instance that he exists in hiding where no one or few can reach him and the instance of his non-existence until his capacity of governance is known and then God creates him.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the Imam's hidden existence and his non-existence before manifestation?
ai.summary: Al-Tusi distinguishes the Imam's occultation (ghaybah) as a state of actual existence with limited accessibility, contrasting it with mere non-existence or potentiality. He argues that the Imam's transition to active manifestation is contingent upon the divine knowledge of his 'capacity to command' (tamakkun), a concept rooted in the principle of divine wisdom (hikmah) ensuring the Imam appears when the world is ready for his authority. This clarifies that the delay in his appearance is not due to absence but to the precise timing ordained by God.
